coverage.note: First coverage measurement in the project (R-016). Final figure measured in Phase 15 on the fully merged 2.6.0 tree (425-test suite, all passing under coverage). Worker E's Phase 11 measurement on its own branch tree (394 tests) read 52.41% (6,434/12,277); an earlier same-day measurement over the 388-test phase-start tree read 52.15% (6,403/12,277).
coverage.scope: line coverage of scripts/ (module scripts + narlib) as executed in-process by the unit suite
coverage.tool: coverage.py 7.17.5 (installed into the test venv for this measurement; test-side only, shipped code remains stdlib-only)

method: Identical harness discipline to baseline-2.5.2.json: each measurement ran the command once in a fresh wrapper process; peak RSS is the wrapper's RUSAGE_CHILDREN ru_maxrss (the direct child's own peak; grandchildren excluded), wall is subprocess wall time. Inputs are byte-identical to the 2.5.2 W0 inputs, verified by size: both IoStore sets (885,376 B .utoc / 219,935,664 B .ucas and 327,627 B .utoc / 97,140,736 B .ucas), the largest ELF extracted from the 273 MB fixture (81,159,656 B, arm64 shared library), and the 273 MB fixture itself (273,366,540 B, bound via the NAR_FIXTURES manifest role FIX_UNITY_BUNDLES). Local path bindings live outside the repo (role labels only here). Load note: the three short runs were measured on a quiet box section; the analyze run shared the box with this phase's coverage and unit-suite runs and with parallel program workers, so its wall is load-inflated and its peak RSS is the comparable figure.
program: NAR 2.6.0 upgrade — Phase 11 benchmark extension (Worker E)

Wall is NOT comparable this run: the box was shared with the phase's coverage run, unit suite and parallel workers (the 2.5.2 W0 record makes the same shared-load caveat in reverse). format_identification.note: Bare .uasset/.ucas files are content formats reached through nar-unreal / nar-pak, not intake formats, and identify as unknown by design. The v11 pak result is after the Phase 11/13 tail-window fix (footer magic 204 B from EOF; the 64 B window in 2.5.2 reported this file unknown).

synthetic_accuracy.method: Public synthetic corpus only (tests/synthetic_fixtures.py + tests/expected_outputs.json): fixtures generated fresh, parsed with the shipped parsers, and every field asserted by tests/unit/test_synthetic_fixtures.py counted as checked/matched (parser output vs builder intent). Format identification ran narlib.formats.identify over each generated file. Measured 2026-11-24 on this tree.
